Fix: Settings → Elevated-window injection → turn on “Also in elevated windows” and click “Start elevated process” (one UAC prompt). The UAC prompt itself, lock screen and login screen (secure desktop) remain unreachable by design. If you trigger a shortcut in an elevated window without this switch on, Kada posts a hint in Messages.
